text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: gpu-memory-pressure-west2 (severity: P2). 12 alerts in last 2m. nvml: Out of memory on GPU 0 on node infer-west2a-03.

pagerduty: Incident PD-78912 created and routed to the on-call.

kamal: Acked. I'm on it — grabbing logs and checking pool metrics.

sophia: Noted. I'm pulling customer impact dashboard.

kamal: logs: ```[2024-04-05T12:14:02Z] nvml: cudaErrorIllegalAddress on alloc 256MB
[2024-04-05T12:14:03Z] model-server[kvs]: kv_cache eviction spike -> mem pressure``` Trying to repro on node.

ena: We saw spike in prefetched KV-cache for model rdx-3b-quant. Could be prefetch thrash.

matt: Can we drain traffic from infer-west2a-03 and restart the model process? low-risk.

kamal: Starting drain on node infer-west2a-03 :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ops-bot: Drain initiated: node infer-west2a-03 -> cordon true, migrate active sessions 7/12.

sophia: Customer impact: 0.8% of requests in west2 are getting 503s with latency spikes. Affected customers flagged: acme-data, betasearch (low severity).

kamal: Restarting model-server on infer-west2a-03 now.

ops-bot: model-server restart command: `sudo systemctl restart rdx-model@rdx-3b.service` executed by kamal.

kamal: Restart complete. Monitoring KV evictions and GPU memory. :eyes: 

matt: Suggest reducing KV prefetch from 32->8 for rdx-3b-quant as temporary mitigation.

ena: Rolling a config change to reduce prefetch on a small canary pool.

pagerduty: PD-78912 acknowledged by kamal. Escalation to eng-runtime if no recovery in 10m.

sophia: Notifying CS to inform acme-data about intermittent 503s (sent DM).

kamal: Memory stable on node, eviction rate down 70%. Rebalancing traffic back.

ops-bot: Drain complete, node back in rotation.

sophia: Marking incident as mitigated. Will watch for recurrence. :white_check_mark: 

kamal: Follow-ups: 1) perf-test rdx-3b-quant prefetch sensitivity 2) add circuit-breaker on prefetched KV policy 3) run a job to detect prefetch thrash and autoreduce.

matt: I'll own the follow-ups. Assigning ticket: INF-3245.

pagerduty: PD-78912 resolved (mitigated).

ena: Great job team, nice fast triage. :tada:
